architecture.intervention: incorporate spacer structures within the hollow-fiber membrane module to create turbulence and shear forces at membrane surface
architecture.expected_effect: reduced accumulation of soluble microbial products and extracellular polymeric substances on membrane fibers, maintaining permeability and extending chemical cleaning intervals
architecture.falsification_test: compare membrane performance with and without spacer structures under identical operating conditions (8 g/L MLSS, target flux 18 LMH) for 6 months
